text: Chess is, above all, a fight.
author: Emanuel Lasker

text: Chess is something more than a game. It is an intellectual diversion with artistic qualities and scientific elements.
author: José Raúl Capablanca

text: Chess is a very logical game and it is the man who can reason most logically and profoundly in it that ought to win.
author: José Raúl Capablanca

text: Chess can open up a kid's brain, and develop it in a playful creative way. They can learn playfully about creative, strategic, and logical thinking, and quick problem-solving.
author: Judit Polgar

text: Chess is a beautiful game because it combines logic and creativity.
author: Viswanathan Anand

text: Chess is a game of constant growth and self-improvement.
author: Judit Polgar

text: In chess, as in life, the value of persistence cannot be overstated.
author: Judit Polgar

text: Chess is a game of strategy, and it teaches you to think ahead and plan your moves.
author: Viswanathan Anand

text: One must change one's tactics every ten years if one wishes to maintain one's superiority.
author: Napoleon Bonaparte

text: Chess helps you to concentrate, improve your logic, teaches you to play by the rules and take responsibility for your actions.
author: Garry Kasparov

text: Chess is the gymnasium of the mind — a beautiful mental workout that strengthens the soul.
author: Peter Pratt
